{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing non-numeric characters
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('[^0-9.]', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for test orders: look for order_id containing 'TEST'
test_orders = sales_df[sales_df['order_id'].str.contains('TEST', na=False)]

# Exclude test orders from completed orders
completed_non_test = completed_orders[~completed_orders['order_id'].str.contains('TEST', na=False)]

# Total revenue from completed orders excluding test orders
total_revenue_completed_non_test = completed_non_test['revenue'].sum()

# Confirm no test orders were found
test_order_count = len(test_orders)

# Confirm how many completed orders have zero revenue
zero_revenue_completed_count = (completed_non_test['revenue'] == 0.0).sum()

total_revenue_completed_non_test, test_order_count, zero_revenue_completed_count"}
